headline: Ascentium Acquires Statura to Expand Private Client Business in Europe and Middle East
summary: Singapore-based business services platform Ascentium completed the acquisition of Statura, an independent cross-border provider, expanding its network across Europe and the Middle East.
why: Cross-border corporate acquisitions in the financial and business services sector drive market consolidation and geographic footprint expansion.

impacts.name: Ascentium
impacts.why: Ascentium is expanding its business through the acquisition of Statura.
